Carol: Hi Paulo.
Carol: It's great to hear from you! Congratulations on your new tours in Brooklyn! What are the tourists like?
Carol: I'm writing to tell you that I'm coming to New York next month, and I'd like to see you if you're interested in showing me around.
Carol: I'll be in the city from Friday to Sunday. We could go to that pizza place we went to last year. Or maybe you have a new favorite place? Let me know what you think. I promise to be on time this time!
Carol: Anyway, I have to go now. I've just finished work, and I'm going to the gym. Did I tell you that I've given up eating sugar? I haven't had any dessert for three weeks! And fruit tastes amazing now.
Carol: Love, Carol.
